surface: The autocomplete editor: opening it on a cell, arrowing through its choices, typing to narrow the list, and Enter committing the choice.

steps.note: Enter opens the editor on the cell holding `Al`: a text field with the combobox role over a listbox of the choices that match `Al` (Alpha, Alfa, Alto). Required: the text, the role and the open list (`expanded`, on every reader). The field's role, a combo box: VoiceOver with Chromium calls it a `text entry area` with a `list box pop up`, its words for a field that opens a list. Finding: VoiceOver with WebKit names no role, only `expanded group 9 items`.

ArrowDown highlights the first choice. The focus stays in the text field and aria-activedescendant names the option, so a reader should read the option. Finding: with Chromium neither reader names the option: NVDA says `list. section` and VoiceOver reads the field's group (`Al and 1 more item group`), on this step and the next two. NVDA with Firefox adds the position (`1 of 3`).

Typing `f` after `Al` rebuilds the list with Alfa, the one choice that matches `Alf`, and leaves no choice highlighted. The list is a polite live region, so the change should be read without a focus move (4.1.3). Finding: only NVDA with Firefox reads the narrowed list (`Alfa, 2 of 3`), in one recording of three after the window title and the document; NVDA with Chromium says an object character and `section`, and VoiceOver reads the field's text (`Alf`) or its group, and no choice.
ArrowDown highlights Alfa, the one choice left, so that Enter commits it: without this step Enter commits the typed text, `Alf`. Finding: nothing is said on any reader when the highlight lands on it.

Enter commits Alfa and moves the selection one row down (enterMoves), to the next row's cell, which holds `Al`. Required: that cell's value and its row. Finding: the focus stays on the closed editor's field, still a combo box, now collapsed and holding the next cell's value, so a reader hears `combo box, collapsed, Al` and no reader says the row the selection moved to (NVDA and VoiceOver; NVDA with Firefox said nothing here in the recording). The text and handsontable editors give the focus to the cell. VoiceOver names no row on any cell move (its behavior, grid-core).
ArrowUp moves to the edited cell, which now holds the committed choice, `Alfa`. Every reader reads the cell: the arrow key takes the focus from the closed field back to the grid.
